register.labelZh: ADD 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: add on 和 add on to something 可以表示在原有建築物上加建,而不需要搬到另一座建築物。；add something in 可以表示把費用包括在計算內;add something on 則可以表示在原有價錢上再加收費用。；你可以把數字加起來,也可以表示多項因素共同造成某個結果,或說明多筆款項合計為某個總額。；add up 可以自然地表示某個說法、解釋、日期或一組數字是否合理。
register.summaryEn: Add on and add on to something let you explain that an extra part is being built without moving to another building. Add something in can show that a cost is included in a calculation. Add something on can show that an extra charge is placed on an existing price. You can add numbers together, explain that several things added together to create a result, or say that amounts add up to a total. Add up is a natural way to say that a story, explanation, date or set of numbers does or does not make sense.
